text: Bitcoin's modest overnight gain and elevated dominance at 55.6% suggest cautious consolidation after recent losses, while Ethereum's stronger 4.8% move indicates selective risk appetite in altcoins despite the extreme fear reading. The Fear & Greed index at 21, though still deeply pessimistic, has improved 8 points over a week—a sign some capitulation may be pricing in—but the $85B daily volume remains subdued, indicating conviction remains thin across both majors. This pattern typically reflects a market in early recovery rather than renewed confidence, where traders are testing support levels while hedging against further downside.
